protocol.head_selection: maximize mean(accuracy, 3-class macro-F1) on validation; ties: positive recall, then grid order
protocol.numeric_precision: float64 fit; frozen coefficients and predictions use float32 export with float64 arithmetic
protocol.text_head: 2048 inputs: signed normalized 1-3 character n-grams (1024) + either another hash seed (1024) or normalized frozen Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (1024)
protocol.training_text: official train captions; select text heads on official validation captions
protocol.validation_fusion: fixed raw validation cohort, file-entry ASR and exact training encoders
protocol.audio_visual_weight_grid: with audio head: [1, s, v], s and v in {0.125, 0.5, 1.5}; without: [0,1,v] same v grid
protocol.fusion_selection: audio/visual weights fixed using validation without text; then select text weight on mean objective over observed, hide_audio and hide_visual; same AV weights in matched Qwen ablation
protocol.decision: maximum weighted mean class score; omit absent blocks, abstain when no usable inputs
protocol.test: same fixed 48 hash-selected official test videos, no fitting or threshold selection
